messages:
Gwen: Heads-up 15-min preflight for AuroraHealth renewal demo Thu 10am PT. Pasting a short runbook (warmup + quick probe + customer-facing autofallback script).

Leo: Love the short flow. Suggest call out token estimate for warmup and a reproducible p99 probe.

Hana: Proposed 10-min runbook to paste into invite:
1) Align goal (30s) - confirm availability + acceptable phrasing variance.
2) Warmup (3m) - send 6 exact demo prompts (3 short, 3 medium) to prime KV cache and batching lanes.
3) Quick probe (2m) - run the one-liner and read p50/p95/p99 + kv-hit%.
4) Autofallback walkthrough (3m) - show toggling to a faster model or auto-route, explain expected changes.
5) Close (1.5m) - record owners and next steps.

Leo: Probe one-liner for live shell:
```bash
python tools/latency_probe.py --tenant aurora --model open-7b --n 24 --json | jq -r '.summary | "p50:\(.p50) p95:\(.p95) p99:\(.p99) kv_hit:\(.kv_hit)"'
```

Gwen: Customer-facing autofallback blurb to paste in invite notes: "If we observe sustained latency above the agreed threshold, we will switch to a lower-latency model variant (automatically or manually) to preserve responsiveness. This keeps the demo live but may slightly change phrasing. We will capture any regressions, notify you immediately, and follow up with recommended prompt tweaks and a remediation plan."

Hana: Ops cheats: keep Console on Per-route, have the routing override ready, and label logs for 45m: `kubectl label pods -n prod tenant=aurora-demo=true --overwrite`. Pre-warm fallback model in staging.

sre-bot: [deploy] Aurora canary: last deploy 2026-02-28T09:45:00Z. No incidents.

Gwen: Action owners: Leo - attach probe outputs + token estimate; Hana - rehearse autofallback in staging and prep labels; I will paste runbook + customer blurb into the invite. :thumbsup:

Leo: Uploaded probe output and warmup token est (~320-650 tokens) to the invite.

Hana: Rehearsal complete. Autofallback toggle ready.

Gwen: Thanks team. Adding a one-paragraph follow-up template for any quality regressions. See you Thu.
